title: Choose Your Research Story: From Article to Talk
objective: Students learn to turn a paper into a simple presentation story.
context: Report: A class asked which pond had more frogs. It counted nine at the large pond and four at the small pond on one morning. The team wants to visit again.

items.prompt: Give the main question in one sentence.
items.answer: Which pond had more frogs during the visit?
items.hint: Ask which place had more animals.

items.prompt: Make three short notes for a talk: question, result, next step.
items.answer: Compare ponds; nine frogs vs four; visit again.
items.hint: Keep each note under ten words.

items.prompt: Tell your partner the main message in two sentences. Include one limit.
items.answer: More frogs were seen at the large pond on this visit. We need more visits to see if this continues.
items.hint: Start with what the team saw.
